This maintenance generator writes a real source artifact to disk. Replacing its filesystem with memfs would prevent its intended output from being persisted; left unchanged.

Importing vi from the @effect/vitest re-export was tested and fails mock hoisting with "There are some problems in resolving the mocks API". The real Match dispatcher call-count regression requires Vitest spy instrumentation and a direct vi import.

This regression launches the real Node runtime with type stripping to verify extraction of a definition before 150000 shallow paragraph lines without stack overflow. A memory filesystem or fake child process cannot exercise the Node stack or runtime module loading; NodeServices supplies the real process spawner.
